description: Start a NEW PAID run that resumes a job from its last checkpoint on a different supplier. This spends money. It requires confirm set to true and a spend cap in max_spend_usd. Call get_resume_info first, show the user what it returns, and ask the user before calling this tool with confirm true. The request is never retried automatically. Needs KILAWATT_API_KEY.

confirm.description: Must be exactly true, and only after the user has agreed to start a paid run.

duration_seconds.description: Optional run length in seconds, a whole number from 60 to 86400.

job_id.description: The job ID (36 characters, hex digits and dashes).

max_spend_usd.description: Required spend cap in USD for the new run. Must be a positive number.

name: resume_job
